# SharpMD

> SharpMD is a free, open source Markdown editor and reader that runs in the browser, as a web app and as a Chrome extension. You open a .md file or a whole folder and edit on the formatted text. Cloud notes, sharing and an MCP server for AI clients are optional.

- Web app: https://sharpmd.app/src/app.html
- Site: https://sharpmd.app/ (Spanish: https://sharpmd.app/es/)
- Source code: https://github.com/MR-Axel/sharpmd (app under MIT, sync server under AGPL-3.0)
- Contact: hello@sharpmd.app

## What it does

- Edits Markdown in place: click a paragraph, a heading, a list item or a table cell and type. The Markdown source is rewritten block by block.
- Reads GitHub Flavored Markdown plus KaTeX math, Mermaid and Graphviz diagrams, footnotes, task lists, callouts, definition lists and YAML front matter.
- Opens a whole folder: file tree, search across every file, `[[name]]` links, create, rename, move and delete.
- Block menu on right-click: insert a table, code block, diagram, formula or callout; turn into, move, duplicate, delete.
- Tables with totals and formulas (`=sum`, `=avg`, `=min`, `=max`, `=count`, `=median`), kanban boards from task lists, pasted images saved next to the document.
- Exports one standalone HTML file, or PDF through print.
- Interface in English and Spanish.

## Where it runs

- Web app: nothing to install. Chrome, Edge and Brave open folders and save in place. Firefox and Safari open one file at a time and saving downloads a copy.
- Chrome extension: works without a connection and opens local .md files with a double-click once Chrome is the default app for them.
- Sync server: one Node file with SQLite. It can be self-hosted; the app takes its address in Settings.

## Cloud notes and AI

- Sign-in is a six-digit code sent by email, with no password.
- A note reaches the server only when the user sends it to the cloud. Files opened from disk are never uploaded.
- Cloud notes can be shared with another account, to read or to edit, or through a read-only public link with an optional password.
- MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP at https://sync.sharpmd.app/mcp with eight tools: `list_notes`, `list_folders`, `read_note`, `write_note`, `append_note`, `search_notes`, `list_comments`, `resolve_comment`. Authentication is a bearer token the user creates in the app, and a token can be limited to one folder.
- The user can leave a comment on a passage of a note. The AI reads the open comments with `list_comments`, makes the change and closes each one with `resolve_comment`.
- Cloud notes are encrypted at rest on the server, which holds the key so it can share them and serve MCP.
- A folder can be protected with a password. Its notes are encrypted in the browser (AES-256-GCM, key wrapped with PBKDF2) and the server cannot read them. File and folder names stay visible. Protected folders are left out of sharing, public links and MCP, unless the user unlocks one for the AI for a set time; while unlocked, the server holds the key in memory only.

## Plans

- Free: the whole editor, unlimited files and browser notes, 10 notes in the cloud.
- Paid: USD 3.99 a month or USD 39 a year. Unlimited cloud notes, sharing and public links, the MCP connection, 30 days of version history, and colors, fonts and custom CSS.

## Privacy

- No analytics. Details: https://sharpmd.app/privacy.html
